scientific_integrity: Exact operator-norm approximation and Hilbert--Schmidt integral identities follow analytically from a Gaussian change of variables and Fourier Plancherel; finite diagnostics are supplementary, not proofs. Novelty relates to explicit compact non-Hilbert--Schmidt examples with a sharp threshold, not to prior general compactness and integral tests.
scientific_limitations: The construction is confined to the classical Gaussian Fock space in one complex variable, affine symbol with real slope in (0,1), and the Hilbert--Schmidt class. Generalized radial Fock weights and other Schatten exponents are not classified. Broad prior Fock-Schatten characterizations give membership tests but full 2013/2015 Mengestie texts were unavailable; independent publication-priority comparison remains advisable.
title: A compact non-Hilbert--Schmidt weighted composition operator on the Gaussian Fock space: an exact transition
